craft_notes: Sthāyin: hiding-and-spreading (saṃchādya…prathayeta: having HIDDEN…would spread FORTH — concealment rhymed with revelation). Sanskrit-first: anavacchinnaprakāśaśivarūpatayaiva (as unlimited-light-Śiva-nature ITSELF — identity, not likeness). Abhinavagupta frame: svātantrya performed — freedom/bliss, wonder/will, light/awareness, grasp/knowing, fitness/action: each power named IS the autonomy proved. CORRECTED this pass: the old song had dropped ‘hiding his own nature’ + ‘will, knowing, action’ — the very concealment its own craft celebrated; restored from L3 (subset-safe: every restored word is L3's). Rows: 9 (powers drumbeat kept bare — doctrine resists ornament), 1 (pūrṇam end-weighted ‘full’: the song and the work end open-full), 5 (śāstra-tread: long catalogue-close line; bank: fidelity-first, music in the joints). Close: ‘to spread it full’. Rejected: keeping the old compressed close — killed: lost saṃchādya, the verse's engine; ornamenting the atom-line — killed: contraction stated plain; restoring ‘here taught’ — killed: UNC defers the fourth to the work. Read aloud: REST-ing in OWN-bliss, ŚI-va — con-TRACT-ing, CALLED-a-tom; HID-ing his OWN-na-ture … WILL, KNOW-ing, AC-tion — THREE-fold, FOUR-fold — to SPREAD it FULL.

lines: Own-nature alone most adoptable — light-nature of all, since non-light cannot be nature;
one, autonomous, everywhere. Its freedom bliss, its wonder will,
its light awareness, its grasp knowing, all-form-fitness action —
resting in own bliss, Śiva — contracting, called atom; hiding his own nature, showing again with means or without: will, knowing, action — threefold, fourfold — to spread it full.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra iha svabhāvaḥ eva paramopādeyaḥ saḥ ca sarvabhāvānām prakāśarūpaḥ eva aprakāśasya svabhāvatānupapatteḥ saḥ ca nānekaḥ prakāśasya taditarasvabhāvānupraveśāyoge svabhāvabhedābhāvāt deśakālāv api ca asya na bhedakau tayor api tatprakāśasvabhāvatvāt iti ekaḥ eva prakāśaḥ saḥ eva ca saṃvit arthaprakāśarūpā hi saṃvit sarveṣām atra avivādaḥ eva saḥ ca prakāśaḥ na paratantraḥ prakāśyatā eva hi pāratantryam prakāśyatā ca prakāśāntarāpekṣitā eva na ca prakāśāntaram kiṃcit asti iti svatantraḥ ekaḥ prakāśaḥ svātantryād eva ca deśakālākārāvacchedavirahāt vyāpakaḥ nityaḥ sarvākāranirākārasvabhāvaḥ tasya ca svātantryam ānandaśaktiḥ taccamatkāraḥ icchāśaktiḥ prakāśarūpatā cicchaktiḥ āmarśātmakatā jñānaśaktiḥ ity evam mukhyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ yukto 'pi vastutaḥ icchājñānakriyāśaktiyuktaḥ anavacchinnaḥ prakāśaḥ nijānandaviśrāntaḥ śivarūpaḥ saḥ eva svātantryāt ātmānam saṃkucitam avabhāsayan aṇuḥ iti ucyate punar api ca svātmānam svatantratayā prakāśayati yena anavacchinnaprakāśaśivarūpatayaiva prakāśate tatrāpi svātantryavaśāt anupāyam eva svātmānam prakāśayati sopāyaṃ vā sopāyatve 'pi icchā vā jñānam vā kriyā vā abhyupāyaḥ iti traividhyam śāmbhavaśāktāṇavabhedena samāveśasya tatra caturvidham api etad rūpam krameṇa atra upadiśyate ātmā prakāśavapuḥ eṣaḥ śivaḥ svatantraḥ svātantryanarmarabhasena nijam svarūpam saṃchādya yat punar api prathayeta pūrṇam tat ca kramākramavaśāt athavā tribhedāt

reads_against.argmap: What is own-nature, and how does it hide and spread? → Own nature alone is to be adopted: one autonomous light-consciousness, resting in own bliss as Śiva; contracting itself, called atom; re-manifesting with or without means — will, knowing, action (three immersions) plus a fourth; the self hiding then spreading its own nature, stepwise or at once.
c1_essence: Own-nature alone is adoptable: one autonomous light-consciousness, all-pervading, eternal, form and formless; autonomy is bliss, wonder is will, light is consciousness, grasp is knowing, all-fitness is action; resting in own bliss it is Śiva, contracting itself called atom, re-manifesting with or without means — will, knowing, action, three immersions plus a fourth taught here in order.
